title: VMStackPreferences
description: User preferences and configuration for vm-stack local virtual machine management.

cache_os_images.description: Whether to cache downloaded base OS images locally in ~/.config/vm-stack/cache/ for fast VM provisioning.

default_arch.description: Default target architecture for newly created VMs.

default_memory.description: Default RAM memory allocation for new VMs (e.g. '4G', '8G').

default_cpus.description: Default vCPU core count for new VMs.

default_accel.description: Default acceleration framework to use ('hvf' on macOS, 'kvm' on Linux, 'whpx' on Windows, or 'tcg').

images_dir.description: Custom directory path for VM disk images. Defaults to ~/.config/vm-stack/images/ when empty.

cache_dir.description: Custom directory path for cached base OS images. Defaults to ~/.config/vm-stack/cache/ when empty.
